create_sarima_params: create SARIMAParams with p, d, q orders and optional seasonal_order tuple for a SARIMA model
fit_sarima_model: fit a SARIMAModel to univariate time series data using maximum likelihood estimation via Kalman filter
predict_sarima_forecast: predict future values from a fitted SARIMAModel returning forecasts with confidence intervals as a DataFrame
predict_sarima_with_history: predict SARIMA forecasts including historical fitted values and confidence intervals for the full time series
get_sarima_search_space: get the default SARIMA parameter search space dictionary for hyperparameter tuning via get_parameter_search_space
